z-m-12-11.title: Ibhokisi elimbozwe liyi-A noma i-B?
z-m-12-11.topic: Ukuqagela ukuthi kungenzeka kangakanani ngemiphumela yesivivinyo
z-m-12-11.goal: Isikhathi ngasinye lapho inani lamabhola adwetshiwe likhula, guqula isahlulelo sakho nokuzethemba ngokuthi ibhokisi lingu-A noma u-B, bese uchaza ukuthi uma imiphumela ingahambisani kahle nanoma yimuphi umbhokisi, ungabaza ukucabanga kwakho kokuqala.
z-m-12-11.material: Amabhokisi u-A no-B ngamunye anamabhola angu-10 anosayizi ofanayo. U-A unamabhola abomvu angu-3 aluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka angu-7, futhi u-B unabomvu abangu-7 neluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka olungu-3. Uthisha wakhetha elilodwa lamabhokisi amabili walimboza. Uphinda lokhu: uthatha ibhola elilodwa ebhokisini elimbozwe, ubheka umbala walo, ulibuyisela, bese uxuba. Ibhola ngalinye linethuba elilinganayo lokudwetshwa.

z-m-12-07.title: Ama-cm² angaki ku-1 m²?
z-m-12-07.goal: Qonda ukuthi kungani ubudlelwano bamayunithi obude (1 m = 100 cm) ngeke bubuyiselwe ngqo emayunithini endawo, yenza onxande abaningana abanendawo engu-1 m² usebenzisa u-cm, bese uchaza ukuze umfowenu omncane aqonde.
z-m-12-07.material: Iklasi luka-Jiho ifuna ukwenza indawo yokufunda enendawo engu-1 m² ncamashi ohlangothini olulodwa lweklasi. U-Jiho uthe, "1 m ungu-100 cm, ngakho 1 m² ungu-100 cm²." Umfowabo omncane u-Harin, osebangeni lesi-3, weva lokhu futhi wadideka. Amayunithi obude angu-cm no-m, futhi amayunithi endawo angu-cm² no-m². (cm² ifundwa "square centimeter," futhi m² ifundwa "square meter.")
z-m-12-07.thinking.0: Ukuthola iphutha lokuthatha ubudlelwano bobude ngqo uye endaweni
z-m-12-07.prereq.1: Ubudlelwano phakathi kwamayunithi obude u-cm no-m
z-m-12-07.s.s1.prompt: U-Jiho uxazulule kanje ngenkathi ecabanga ngesikwele esinezinhlangothi ezingu-1 m. Khetha umugqa owodwa ongalungile.
z-m-12-07.s.s1.hint.0: Phawula umugqa ngamunye njengokhuluma ngo-"bude" noma u-"ndawo."
z-m-12-07.s.s1.hint.1: Thola ngqo indawo yesikwele esinohlangothi olungu-100 cm nge-cm bese uyiqhathanisa nesiphetho sesixazululo.
z-m-12-07.s.s1.line.0: Cabanga ngendawo eyisikwele enezinhlangothi ezingu-1 m.
z-m-12-07.s.s1.line.2: Indawo yesikwele ngu-(uhlangothi)×(uhlangothi), ngakho 1 m × 1 m = 1 m².
z-m-12-07.s.s1.line.3: 1 m ungu-100 cm, ngakho 1 m² ungu-100 cm².
z-m-12-07.s.s1.explain: Umugqa 4 awulungile. Ngobude, 1 m = 100 cm, kodwa ngendawo, 100 cm × 100 cm = 10000 cm². 100 cm² yindawo nje yesikwele esinezinhlangothi ezingu-10 cm.
z-m-12-07.s.s2.prompt: Ufuna ukwenza indawo yokufunda ibe unxande onendawo engu-1 m² ncamashi. Nquma ububanzi nobude nge-cm bese uzifaka. Ububanzi nobude kuyizinombolo eziphelele kusukela ku-40 cm kuya ku-250 cm, futhi ukushintshanisa ububanzi nobude kubalwa njengesimo esifanayo, ngakho kubale kanye kuphela. Thola izimo ezingu-3 ezihlukile.
z-m-12-07.s.s2.hint.0: Khetha ububanzi, bese ucabanga, ushintshela ku-m, ukuthi ubude kumele bube yini ukuze ububanzi × ubude bube ngu-1 m².
z-m-12-07.s.s2.hint.1: Kumapheya owathole, bhala umphumela wobubanzi nobude bese uhlola ukuthi wonke ayafana.
z-m-12-07.s.s2.fail.c1: Sicela ufake ububanzi nobude njengezinombolo zemvelo.
z-m-12-07.s.s2.ok.c2: Kungu-40 cm noma ngaphezulu futhi ngu-250 cm noma ngaphansi.
z-m-12-07.s.s2.fail.c2: Ububanzi nobude kumele kube ngu-40 cm okungenani futhi ngu-250 cm ngokuphezulu.
z-m-12-07.s.s2.fail.c3: Indawo ayingu-1 m². Shintsha ububanzi nobude bube ngu-m bese uziphindaphinda.
z-m-12-07.s.s2.explain: Uma indawo ingu-1 m², ingu-10000 nge-cm². 100×100, 50×200, 80×125, no-40×250 konke kuhambisana nemibandela (ukushintshanisa ububanzi nobude kuyisimo esifanayo). Lawa amapheya lapho umkhiqizo wobubanzi nobude ungu-10000.
z-m-12-07.s.s3.prompt: Chaza ngendlela elula kuHarin ukuthi kungani u-1 m² ungu-10000 cm², hhayi u-100 cm². UHarin uyakwazi ukuphindaphinda namagridi e-cm, kodwa amayunithi endawo amasha kuye. Kuhle ukubhala ngokungathi udweba isithombe ngamagama.
z-m-12-07.s.s3.hint.0: Zama ukuqala ngokusho lokho uHarin akwaziyo kakade (ukuphindaphinda, izikwele ezingu-1 cm).
z-m-12-07.s.s3.hint.1: Cabanga ukugcwalisa isikwele esinezinhlangothi ezingu-1 m ngezikwele ezingu-1 cm, futhi ubale ukuthi mangaki izikwele ezingena emugqeni owodwa nokuthi mangaki imigqa.

Kunezikwele ezingu-100 ngaphesheya, futhi kunemigqa enjalo engu-100 iya phansi. Ngakho kunezikwele ezingu-100×100=10000, futhi u-1 m² ungu-10000 cm².
z-m-12-07.s.s3.model.1: Harin, cabanga ukumboza iphepha elikhulu elingu-1 m² ngezingcezu ezincane zephepha elinemibala elingu-1 cm² ngalinye. Izingcezu ezingu-100 zingena emugqeni owodwa, futhi kunemigqa enjalo engu-100. Ngezingcezu ezingu-100 emugqeni ngamunye wemigqa engu-100, kunezingcezu ezingu-10000 ngokuphelele, ngakho u-1 m² ungu-10000 cm².
z-m-12-07.s.s3.model.2: Indawo yesikwele esingu-100 cm ububanzi no-100 cm ubude ngu-100×100, okungu-10000 cm². Noma ubude buphindwe izikhathi ezingu-100, ububanzi nobude bobabili buphindwe izikhathi ezingu-100, ngakho indawo iba izikhathi ezingu-100×100.

z-m-12-02.title: Singayethemba indlela kaSeoa yokunciphisa?
z-m-12-02.topic: Ukwenza izingxenyana zosayizi ofanayo nomgomo wokunciphisa izingxenyana
z-m-12-02.goal: Hlola umcabango othi "ukwenza into efanayo kunombolo ephansi nephezulu" kugcina usayizi ufana, bese uchaza ukuthi yimiphi imisebenzi egcina usayizi wengxenyana nesimo esikhethekile lapho indlela kaSeoa isebenza khona.
z-m-12-02.material: USeoa wabhala umsebenzi wakhe wokwenza lula u-4/8 (okuyisishiyagalombili sesine). Ukunciphisa ingxenyana kusho ukwenza inombolo ephansi nephezulu zibe zincane kuyilapho usayizi wengxenyana usala unjalo. USeoa uyazi ukuthi "uma wenza into efanayo kunombolo ephansi nephezulu, usayizi usala unjalo." Ake sithole ukuthi singawethemba yini umsebenzi kaSeoa.

z-m-12-02.thinking.2: Ukuthola isimo lapho indlela isebenza ngenhlanhla khona
z-m-12-02.s.s1.prompt: Ufuna ukuhlola ukuthi indlela kaSeoa ingethenjwa yini. Ungathola kanjani ngokuqinisekile kakhulu?
z-m-12-02.s.s1.hint.0: Cabanga ukuthi iyiphi ingxenyana engenza kube lula ukuhlola umphumela lapho uzama indlela kaSeoa.
z-m-12-02.s.s1.hint.1: Cabanga ngendlela yokusebenzisa indlela engxenyaneni osuvele wazi usayizi wayo bese uqhathanisa umphumela nosayizi wokuqala.
z-m-12-02.s.s1.o.a: Dweba u-4/8 no-2/6 njengezithombe bese ubheka ukuthi zibukeka cishe zinosayizi ofanayo yini.
z-m-12-02.s.s1.r.a: Ukubukeka kufana akusona ubufakazi bokulingana. Imehluko emincane inzima ukuyibona ngeso.
z-m-12-02.s.s1.o.b: Sebenzisa indlela engxenyaneni u-2/4 (ingxenye), osuyazi impendulo yayo, bese ubona ukuthi inani lisala linjalo yini.
z-m-12-02.s.s1.r.b: Lo ngumcabango wokuthi ukuthi indlela isebenza yini kungahlolwa ngokushesha ngokuyisebenzisa lapho usuvele wazi impendulo.
z-m-12-02.s.s1.o.c: Bala futhi u-8-2 no-4-2 ukubona ukuthi uSeoa wakhipha kahle yini.
z-m-12-02.s.s1.r.c: Ukubala kulungile nendlela ilungile kuyindaba ehlukile.
z-m-12-02.s.s1.o.d: Njengoba enze "into efanayo," indlela kumele nayo ibe ilungile, ngakho qhubeka.
z-m-12-02.s.s1.r.d: Noma wenza into efanayo kunombolo ephansi nephezulu, umphumela ungashintsha kuye ngokuthi ukwengeza, ukukhipha, ukuphindaphinda noma ukuhlukanisa.
z-m-12-02.s.s1.explain: Uma uzama indlela engxenyaneni osuvele wazi impendulo yayo, ungakwazi ukusho ngokushesha ukuthi indlela igcina usayizi yini. U-2/4 uyingxenye (1/2), kodwa uma ukhipha u-1 ngendlela efanayo, uba ngu-1/3, futhi usayizi uyashintsha.
z-m-12-02.s.s2.prompt: USeoa washintsha u-4/8 ngezindlela ezimbili wabhala lokhu. Khetha umugqa wokuqala ophosile.
z-m-12-02.s.s2.hint.0: Hlukanisa ukuthi umugqa ngamunye ushiwo umphumela wokubala noma uthi imiphumela emibili iyalingana.

z-m-12-02.s.s2.line.2: Indlela 나: Khipha u-2 ofanayo enombolweni ephansi nephezulu → 2/6.

z-m-12-06.title: Inani lemidlalo emqhudelwaneni lincike kanjani enanini lamaqembu?
z-m-12-06.topic: Ukuhambisana kwamanani amabili (inani lamaqembu nenani lemidlalo)
z-m-12-06.goal: Hlola isicelo esithi "uma amaqembu aphindaphindeka kabili, imidlalo iphindaphindeka kabili" ngesibonelo esiphikisayo, bese uchaza ngokuhlela ukuthi yimuphi ulwazi olwedingeka ngempela ukunquma inani lemidlalo nokuthi yimuphi okungadingeki.
z-m-12-06.material: Le mithetho yomqhudelwano wokudonsa intambo. Iqembu elilahlekile kanye liyaphuma, futhi akukho ukulingana. Amaqembu amabili adlala emdlalweni owodwa. Iqembu elingenaye umlingani lidlulela emjikelezweni olandelayo ngaphandle kokudlala (i-bye), futhi i-bye ayibalwa njengomdlalo. Umqhudelwano uphela uma kusele iqembu elilodwa elinqobile. Ezinye izikole zibambe umdlalo wendawo yesi-3 neyesi-4 futhi ezinye azikwenzi, futhi uma isikole sikubamba, lowo mdlalo ubalwa enanini lemidlalo. Ngamaqembu angu-2 kunomdlalo o-1, futhi ngamaqembu angu-4 kunemidlalo engu-3 (ama-semifinal angu-2, i-final e-1). U-Doyun uthe, "Uma inani lamaqembu liphindaphindeka kabili, inani lemidlalo liphindaphindeka kabili nalo."

z-m-12-08.title: Kwenzekani emjikelezweni wocezu lwephepha elinemibala elinekhoneni elisikiwe?
z-m-12-08.goal: Sebenza ukuthi kwenzekani emjikelezweni nakuba indawo iba incane ngemva kokusika, chaza ukuthi kungani umjikelezo ushintsha uma usika ikhoneni uma kuqhathaniswa nokusika maphakathi nohlangothi, futhi wenze izindlela eziningana zokusika ezihambisana nemibandela.
z-m-12-08.material: Kunocezu lwephepha elinemibala olunxande olungu-10 cm ububanzi no-8 cm ubude. Umjikelezo wonxande wokuqala ungu-36 cm futhi indawo yesimo esisele ingu-68 cm². Umjikelezo wesimo esisele ubude bohambo olulodwa oluzungeze umphetho walo.

z-m-12-10.title: Ukuklama ibhokisi lamabhola: ingabe kunenani elilodwa kuphela lamabhola ahambisana nemibandela?
z-m-12-10.topic: Ukuqhathanisa ukuthi izinto zingenzeka kangakanani nokuhumusha imiphumela yokuhlola
z-m-12-10.goal: Nquma inani lamabhola ngezindlela eziningana ukuze lihambisane nemibandela ngokuthi ngalinye lingakhishwa kangakanani, futhi uchaze ukuthi awukwazi ukuphetha ngokuthi uhlelo alulungile ngoba nje umphumela wokuhlola ngokuzama okumbalwa uhlukile ohlelweni.
z-m-12-10.material: Iqembu likaMina lifaka amabhola abomvu, aluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka, nampunga ebhokisini, livale amehlo futhi likhiphe ibhola elilodwa, lihlole umbala walo, futhi liliphindisele emuva. Amabhola anosayizi nesisindo esifanayo futhi axutshwe kahle, ngakho wonke ibhola linethuba elilinganayo lokukhishwa. Imibandela yokuklama ibhokisi imi kanje. Inani lamabhola abomvu liphindwe ngqo izikhathi ezingu-3 inani lamabhola ampunga. Inani lamabhola aluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka lilingana noma likhulu kunenani lamabhola ampunga, futhi lingaphansi kwenani lamabhola abomvu. Faka okungenani ibhola elingu-1 lombala ngamunye wemibala emithathu, futhi kunamabhola okungenani angu-10 futhi angaphezu kwamabhola angu-24 ngokuphelele.

z-m-12-10.thinking.2: Ukuhlela ukungaqondi kahle kokuthi imiphumela edlule ishintsha ukuthi okulandelayo kungenzeka kangakanani
z-m-12-10.prereq.0: Ukuqhathanisa ukuthi izinto zingenzeka kangakanani ngamagama (izinga leBanga 5)
z-m-12-10.s.s1.prompt: Yenza imiklamo emi-3 ehlukene yebhokisi ehambisana nemibandela. Faka izinombolo zamabhola abomvu, aluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka, nampunga.
z-m-12-10.s.s1.hint.0: Uma usukhethe inani lamabhola ampunga, inani lamabhola abomvu linqunyiwe. Zama ukuthi mangaki amabhola ampunga angenza isamba sibe phakathi kwebanga.
z-m-12-10.s.s1.hint.1: Ngemva kokukhetha izinombolo zabomvu nampunga, hlola ibanga lezinombolo lamabhola aluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka angaba yilo, phakathi kwalezo zinombolo ezimbili, futhi ufanise isamba.
z-m-12-10.s.s1.ok.c1: Umbala ngamunye kwemithathu uyinombolo yemvelo engu-1 okungenani.
z-m-12-10.s.s1.fail.c1: Sicela ufake inombolo yemvelo engu-1 okungenani yayo yonke imibala emithathu.
z-m-12-10.s.s1.ok.c2: Amabhola abomvu aphindwe izikhathi ezingu-3 amabhola ampunga.
z-m-12-10.s.s1.fail.c2: Inani lamabhola abomvu aliphindwe izikhathi ezingu-3 inani lamabhola ampunga.
z-m-12-10.s.s1.ok.c3: Amabhola aluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka okungenani alingana nawampunga futhi ancane kunabomvu.
z-m-12-10.s.s1.fail.c3: Inani lamabhola aluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka kumele okungenani lilingane nenani lamabhola ampunga futhi libe lincane kunenani lamabhola abomvu.
z-m-12-10.s.s1.ok.c4: Kunamabhola okungenani angu-10 futhi angaphezu kwamabhola angu-24 ngokuphelele.
z-m-12-10.s.s1.fail.c4: Inani eliphelele lamabhola aliphakathi kuka-10 no-24. Shintsha inani lamabhola ampunga futhi ubheke isamba.
z-m-12-10.s.s1.explain: Ukuba namabhola ampunga angu-2, 3, noma 4 kuyenzeka. Isibonelo, (obomvu, oluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka, mpunga) = (6, 2, 2) unesamba esingu-10, futhi 6=3×2, 2≥2, 2<6. (6, 5, 2), (9, 4, 3), no-(12, 6, 4) nabo basebenza. Uma kunebhola o-1 elingu-mpunga, isamba asifinyeleli ku-10, futhi uma kunamabhola angu-5 noma ngaphezulu, sidlula u-24.
z-m-12-10.s.s2.prompt: UMina wenze ibhokisi elinamabhola abomvu angu-6, aluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka angu-2, nampunga angu-2 futhi wakhipha izikhathi eziyi-10, futhi wathola obomvu izikhathi ezi-5, mpunga izikhathi ezi-3, noluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka izikhathi ezi-2. Ngoba obomvu abuphindwe izikhathi ezingu-3 mpunga, uMina ucabanga ukuthi uhlelo belungalungile. Iyiphi indlela engcono kakhulu yokubheka?
z-m-12-10.s.s2.hint.0: Beka imiphumela yokukhipha izikhathi eziyi-10 eceleni kwezinombolo ezisebhokisini (6, 2, 2) futhi usho ukuthi yini efanayo nokuthi yini ehlukile.
z-m-12-10.s.s2.hint.1: Cabanga ukuthi ukukhipha izikhathi eziyi-10 futhi ebhokisini elifanayo kungaletha umphumela ofanayo ngqo yini, futhi uqhathanise imiphumela yezigaba ezimbili.
z-m-12-10.s.s2.o.a: Uhlelo alulungile. Uma kunamabhola angu-6, 2, 2, izikhathi zokukhishwa nazo kumele zibe ngu-6, 2, 2.
z-m-12-10.s.s2.r.a: Ucabange ukuthi umlinganiselo wezinombolo zamabhola kumele ubonakale ngqo, njengoba unjalo, ezikhathini zokukhishwa.
z-m-12-10.s.s2.o.b: Uhlelo lulungile. Ngoba mpunga uvele kancane, mpunga unethuba elikhulu lokuvela ngokulandelayo.
z-m-12-10.s.s2.r.b: Uma ubuyisela amabhola futhi uwaxuba, imiphumela yangaphambilini ayishintshi ukuthi okulandelayo kungenzeka kangakanani, kodwa wacabanga ukuthi iyashintsha.
z-m-12-10.s.s2.o.c: Ukukhipha izikhathi eziyi-10 inani elincane, ngakho kungaphuma. Khulisa inani lokukhipha, wenze izikhathi eziningi, futhi uqhathanise.
z-m-12-10.s.s2.r.c: Lo ngumcabango wokubona ukuthi imiphumela yokuzama okumbalwa ingashukunyiswa yithuba futhi nokuzama ukuhlola ngokwandisa inani lokuzama.
z-m-12-10.s.s2.o.d: Obomvu buvele kakhulu, ngakho kufakazelwe ukuthi uhlelo lulungile.
z-m-12-10.s.s2.r.d: Uqinisekise ukuthi uhlelo lulungile ngomphumela wokuhlola okukodwa.
z-m-12-10.s.s2.explain: Ukuthi obomvu bungenzeka izikhathi ezingu-3 kunempunga kusho ukuthi ithuba lokukhishwa liphindwe izikhathi ezingu-3, hhayi ukuthi buvela ngqo izikhathi ezingu-3 kakhulu (izikhathi eziyi-6 neziyi-2) ekukhipheni okuyi-10. Ngokuzama okumbalwa, kungaphuma ngenhlanhla, futhi uma wenza izikhathi eziningi, ngokujwayelekile kusondela kumlinganiselo wezinombolo. Obomvu izikhathi ezi-5 nempunga izikhathi ezi-3 umphumela ongenzeka kahle.
